label: rem:physics-names-knot-operations
title: Physics names $\leftrightarrow$ categorical knot operations (table; depends on $q_0$)
html:
Physics names (alpha particle, gluon condensate, valence shell, isospin) are labels for recurring categorical structures in the Hecke algebra H_n(R, q) at the substrate parameter q_0. The categorical structure is fundamental. The physics naming is a derived mapping that depends on the value of q_0.

This table records the current mapping at q_0 = 1.109978595642739\ldots (muon pin, 16 dps). At a different substrate value, the categorical structures persist but their physics interpretations may differ. The recurring sub-blocks identified by the discovery cache acquire different macroscopic meaning when q_0 changes.

See Table.

Generation of the table. A discovery cache is populated by SDP shadow-price analysis on Hecke Wedderburn blocks. It records each recurring categorical structure as a key. A lookup table maps cache keys to physics names at the current q_0. The categorical cache keys are the source of truth. The physics names are the display layer.

Substrate dependency. Several entries carry "Depends on q_0" annotations. These indicate:

  • The \dim_q V_\lambda factor evaluates to a q_0-dependent number.
  • The recurring sub-block is identified at the algebraic level (categorical structure independent of q_0), but its numerical weight depends on q_0.
  • At a different q_0, the same sub-block exists but may have a different Plancherel weight, possibly vanishing. If the weight vanishes, the physics name no longer applies.

The "alpha particle" identification requires w_{(3,3,3,3)}(q_0) to dominate the depth-3 chirality cells of H_{12}. At q_0 = 1.109978595642739\ldots (muon pin; the run behind this figure is not reproducible from the repository), this weight is \sim 0.024. It is the largest contribution at depth 3. At q_0 = 1 (classical limit), the weight becomes the symmetric-group Specht-module dimension squared over 12!. The ranking changes. The "alpha particle" identification must be re-derived.

Remark. This table is the interface between the categorical machinery (two-strand spectral completeness, uniqueness of the scalar gauge coupling, the chirality / non-chirality mass split) and the physics-language predictions in this chapter. Every physics name in this chapter that does not appear in this table is either an external empirical reference (CODATA, AME) or a forward reference to a later definition.
